candidateAudit.text: Gerstner K. u. K. Hofzuckerbäcker | Palais Todesco | Café Bar Restaurant Shop ♨️♨️♨️♨️♨️ . Apflestrudle, Kardinalschnitte, Barbara Getsner Kaffee, Sisi Veilchen Geschenksdose . A very unique palais style cafe with many rooms with different decoration serving awesome apple strudel complimented very well with its vanilla sauce. Kardinalschnitte is very soft and airy cream with crispy and crackling top skin also nice raspberry jam balancing the sweetness. Barbara getsner has a nice espresso, matched very well with the mozart chocolate liquor! As a closing don’t forget to bring home a nice and unique shape sweet. . #vienna #viennafood #viennafoodie #gerstner #applestrudel

candidateAudit.text: 🥐🤤 BUREK LOVERS, YOU NEED TO TRY THIS SPOT IN VIENNA! 🇦🇹❤️ We tried SO MANY delicious burek flavours at Pitara Oroz and every bite was worth it! 😍 From savoury to sweet, they have something for every craving. 🧀 Cheese burek 🥩 Meat burek 🥬 Spinach & ricotta burek 🥔 Potato burek 🩷 And the surprise favourite… sweet raspberry burek! 🫐🥐 Golden, crispy pastry with delicious fillings, and yes, even a sweet version for those who love dessert! 🤤❤️ The raspberry burek is definitely something different you need to try. 📍 pitaraoroz , Vienna 🇦🇹 Which one would you try first — cheese, meat, spinach, potato or raspberry? 👀👇 Save this spot for your next Vienna food adventure and share it with your burek-loving friend! 🫶 #ViennaFood #Burek #BurekLovers #WienEssen #viennafoodie
